title: SLSpawner
body:
# SLBossSpawner
**Powerful & Optimized Boss Spawning Solution for Minecraft Servers**

*https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f1d30545aa012bd604e5be97f98163a27cc8dc45_0.webp*

SLBossSpawner is a professional-grade Spawner plugin designed specifically for RPG and Survival servers. It provides server administrators with complete control over boss and mob spawning cycles through a robust condition system and highly optimized performance.

<details>
<summary>Click to view Text-based Description (Required for Accessibility)</summary>

## Overview
SLBossSpawner allows you to create customized spawners with advanced logic. It is built to handle complex server environments without causing lag, supporting multiple mob providers and deep integration with popular RPG plugins.

## Key Features
*   **Multi-Provider Support:** Seamlessly works with **MythicMobs**, **Vanilla mobs**, and other custom entities.
*   **Dynamic Conditions:** Set specific spawning requirements such as:
    *   Player proximity (Radius check).
    *   World-specific spawning.
    *   Permission-based triggers.
    *   Maximum entity limits per spawner.
*   **Smart Cooldown System:** Highly customizable spawn intervals and cooldowns after a boss is defeated.
*   **Advanced Spawn Locations:** 
    *   Supports fixed location spawning.
    *   Random offset spawning within a defined area.
*   **In-game Management:** Manage your spawners efficiently using intuitive commands and configurations.
*   **Performance Optimized:** Asynchronous processing where possible to ensure zero impact on Server TPS.
*   **Detailed Logging:** Keep track of spawn events and errors through a clear console logging system.

## Compatibility
*   **Platform:** Paper, Purpur, Spigot (1.16+).
*   **Dependencies:** MythicMobs (Optional but recommended).
*   **PlaceholderAPI:** Full support for custom placeholders in messages and conditions.

## Why choose SLBossSpawner?
Unlike traditional spawners, SLBossSpawner focuses on "Boss Logic"—ensuring that your powerful entities spawn exactly when and where they should, with strict enforcement of server rules to prevent mob farming or lag spikes.
